newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares snap six-day rally on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares snap six-day rally on profit-taking.

text.p: ** (0445 GMT) - Bombay stocks open lower, fall prey to
profit-booking on last day of end-account trade
** Bombay's benchmark 30-share index down 13.38 pts at
** Market seen consolidating at current levels with focus
on action of foreign funds, traders say
** Utility-maker Mahindra & Mahindra gains 4.25 rupees to
347.0 ahead of 1996/97 results due next week
** National exchange index falls 2.20 points at 1,084.40
